Rina: Heads up - noticed per-route quota dashboard shows unexpected spikes for 'nlp-large' after the routing policy rollout. Not matching invoices.
Owen: which rollout? the cost-aware-fallback policy we merged yesterday?
Rina: yep. started canary at 14:02 UTC. dashboard: route=npl-large (sic) saw tokens attributed to fallback_model:quantized instead of the primary alias.
Theo: hmm that's weird. fallback should only be used when capacity low. Do you have a sample request id?
Rina: sample req id: req_20260323_14_07_93. Preview vs invoice delta: preview shows 9.2k tokens on fallback_model, invoice shows 0.
Monica: billing-bot: reconciliation job flagged route-model mismatch for tenant=orchard-app (alert id 8721)
Owen: could be a routing-tiebreak bug where the request was marked as 'fallback' for telemetry but the actual runtime served the primary model, so preview metrics doubled.
Theo: check the routing proxy logs for that req id and the router decision trace.
Rina: router logs: `route_decision: fallback:true, chosen_model:fallback_model:quantized, telemetry_tag:model=fallback_model`
Owen: runtime logs: `served_model: nlp-large-v3, latency_ms: 42` -> so mismatch confirmed. Telemetry tagging happened before final dispatch and never reconciled when the runtime fallback decision flipped.
Monica: immediate mitigation: pause rollout (canary group A), add a reconciliation pass in the telemetry pipeline that compares final served_model to router tag and corrects preview counters when mismatch > threshold.
deploy-bot: canary group A paused for cost-aware-fallback at 14:15 UTC
Theo: for billing safety we should backfill a reconciliation window (14:00-14:20) and adjust preview counters, then run invoice diff to ensure no customer-facing charge changes.
Owen: agree. I'll run a quick backfill job that uses traces to map req_id -> served_model and rewrite preview metrics. Command: `./telemetry_reconcile --from=2026-03-23T14:00:00Z --to=2026-03-23T14:20:00Z --fix=true`
Monica: backfill job 1188 queued (billing-bot estimate 4m)
Monica: backfill finished. Validation query: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM preview_metrics WHERE model='fallback_model' AND ts BETWEEN ...` -> dropped from 9200 to 120 (non-matching tombstones).
Rina: invoice preview parity restored for orchard-app.
Theo: followups: 1) add reconciliation in telemetry pipeline to run before preview emission; 2) gating rule in rollout CI: if routing decision logic touches 'fallback' flags, require integration test that verifies final served_model tag matches telemetry tag; 3) add console alert when preview/invoice model attribution mismatch rate > 0.2% for 10m.
Owen: also add a lightweight e2e where router simulates a capacity flip mid-request to ensure telemetry reconciles.
Rina: filing ticket "fallback-model-telemetry-reconcile" and assigning to Owen/Theo. Marking canary paused until patch and tests in. :white_check_mark:
Monica: billing-bot: alerted finance with reconciliation delta summary (delta_tokens=9080)
Owen: nice catch. moving to postmortem channel after the ticket for a short RCA writeup.
